name: baro_bmp280
title: Barometer
purpose: Pressure sensor (BMP280) on I2C for altitude, with its decoupling

sources.title: Bosch Sensortec BMP280 datasheet, rev. 1.26 (10/2021)
sources.licence: copyright Bosch Sensortec: link and quotes only
sources.read: p2 ranges, p8 supply, p29 interface select and I2C address, p35 pin-out, p38 I2C connection diagram (printed page numbers)

sources.title: KiCad 10 standard libraries (symbols, footprints, 3D models)
sources.read: symbol pin numbers, footprint pads, 3D models

parts.quote: "Pressure range 300 … 1100 hPa (equiv. to +9000…-500 m above/below sea level)"; "Relative accuracy ±0.12 hPa, equiv. to ±1 m"
parts.pin_types_why: bmp280 p35, I2C column: SDO "GND for default address"; p29: "Connecting SDO to GND results in slave address 1110110 (0x76)". In I2C mode SDO sets the address bit, an input tied to GND.

parts.quote: "The recommended value for C1, C2 is 100 nF."
"The recommended value for C1, C2 is 100 nF."

layout.rules: I2C wiring from bmp280 p35/p38: CSB (2) straight to VDDIO ("A direct connection between CSB and VDDIO is recommended"), SDO (5) to GND for address 0x76 (p29: "Connecting SDO to GND results in slave address 1110110 (0x76)"; "The SDO pin cannot be left floating").

open_questions: The vent hole must stay open (no conformal coat over it); light and airflow from the ejection charge affect readings: a foam cover is usual in rocketry, not researched yet.
Range: 300 hPa lower limit is equivalent to about 9000 m (p2), enough for model rockets.
